folkways_updater.config.title: Folkways Updater
folkways_updater.config.subtitle: Base install: Core + Vanilla + LDLib2
folkways_updater.config.exit_help: Downloaded updates install after fully quitting the game.
folkways_updater.config.local_help: Pause only Folkways and dependency checks, downloads and replacement. Updater self-updates remain independent. Legacy markers and a manually installed updater cannot enable this mode.
folkways_updater.config.network_help: Downloads switch automatically between GitHub and github.davisye.cn. Official metadata is verified directly.
folkways_updater.config.commands_help: Enable /restart and /shutdown for permission level 4. Full client restart is not supported; dedicated servers restart after saving.
folkways_updater.config.module_help: Optional integration; requires %s. Version compatibility is checked before staging.
folkways_updater.config.module_missing: Install %s first to enable this optional integration.
folkways_updater.config.region_help: Used only by Region hint network mode; no IP lookup is sent.
folkways_updater.config.check_help: Save these settings, then check and predownload in the background. Existing files stay loaded until the game exits.
folkways_updater.config.load_error: Cannot read config.json. Repair the file before saving.
folkways_updater.config.saved: Saved. Background polling uses the new settings.
folkways_updater.config.busy: Saved; a check is already running.
folkways_updater.config.save_error: Save failed. Check config.json and file permissions, then retry.
folkways_updater.status.idle: Automatic check starts 15 seconds after launch.
folkways_updater.status.checking: Checking and verifying downloads in the background...
folkways_updater.status.local: Local development: only Folkways and dependency updates are paused.
folkways_updater.status.config_error: Cannot read updater settings; current files retained.
folkways_updater.status.self_error: Updater self-check unavailable; current updater retained.
folkways_updater.status.folkways_error: Folkways check failed. Check official API access, selected channel, installed files and dependencies; current files retained.
folkways_updater.status.existing_protect: Existing Folkways files are protected; first installation needs an empty Folkways set.
folkways_updater.status.signed_protected: Existing signed-source ownership is protected; restore its manifest before updating.
folkways_updater.status.folkways_ready: Folkways and dependencies are downloaded; fully quit to install.
folkways_updater.status.self_ready: Updater is downloaded; fully quit to install.
folkways_updater.status.official_unavail: Official GitHub verification is unavailable. Check API access; mirror downloads alone cannot establish trust.
folkways_updater.config.self_help: Update this updater independently of local development mode. Local mode does not disable self-updates.
folkways_updater.status.self_no_target: This IDE run has no installed updater JAR to replace.
folkways_updater.status.self_verificatio: Official updater verification is unavailable; current updater retained. Folkways checks remain independent.
folkways_updater.status.settings_changed: Settings applied; Folkways and updater checks follow their independent switches.
